scripts.dev:all: npm start & npm run dev:sleeper & npm run dev:railpad
scripts.build: CI=false react-scripts build && npm run build:sleeper && npm run build:railpad
scripts.build:sleeper: cd sleeper-vendor && npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p ../build/sleeper-vendor && cp -r dist/* ../build/sleeper-vendor
scripts.build:railpad: cd railpad && npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p ../build/railpad && cp -r dist/* ../build/railpad
